notes: system-rules.md states a 3:1 non-text contrast target but the SVG masters use currentColor and bake no brand colour, so the ratio cannot be measured from the files themselves. This file declares the foreground/background pairs the set is intended to ship with; scripts/check_contrast.py checks them against WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11.
Translucent surfaces are not modelled. If a bar uses a material rather than a solid fill, declare the worst-case backdrop it can show as its own opaque pair - see references/accessibility.md.

pairs.why_decorative: Carries no information and is not a control affordance; state is conveyed by glyph fill vs outline. At 1.23:1 it would fail SC 1.4.11 if it were informational, which is the point of declaring the exemption explicitly rather than leaving it unchecked.
